description: Akifumi Sekihara — Infrastructure and software engineer in Tokyo, working with research software, computational science, and AI agents.
intro: I develop research software and web applications. With a background in materials science and computational chemistry, I currently work as an infrastructure engineer.
software: I have worked on workflow design and the integration of web applications, APIs, and computing infrastructure. I use Codex in development.
science: My research focused on first-principles calculations and catalysts.
education: Graduated from the Department of Chemical Science and Engineering, National Institute of Technology, Tokyo College
interestsText: I am interested in AI agents, their evaluation, and design systems. I would also like to explore AI security and human–agent collaboration.
